To fulfill what China had promised to North Korea in their talks before, China is beginning stage one of the 'Infrastructure Revolution'.

All throughout North Korea, roads remain rotting away, due to lack of modern construction methods. In order to begin the revolution, vehicles must be able to move safely. Thus, China is beginning construction of roads first. With the total area of North Korea being 120,540 km², a fortieth of that, 3,014 km², will become asphalt. This will link major cities, and a majority of smaller ones that are on the way, with top of the line roads, allowing for equipment to be transferred immensely faster than it had been before. For a scale comparison, [the USA has a total of 157,989km² of road](https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20070719230638AAVVZR0). [The total cost for 1 km of road being $210,000 USD](https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20101007071028AAP4j8X), meaning that 3,014 km would cost just shy of $650,000,000. That will not be all of it though, as China will be also paying the workers involved, effectively doubling the cost, to a total cost of $1.3 billion USD. The estimated time frame for this will take a total of 3 years.

After a good amount of the roads are built, energy and communication lines will be introduced. These will be connected to the North Korean military buildings on extra secure connections, preventing others without direct access from gaining information. They will be powered by China's energy production, due to the future improvements of North Korean energy factories. The communication lines will also stem from China, allowing internet service to be at a fast speed, compared to that of a new company. [The total cost for energy lines will be $242,335 per kilometer](http://www.elp.com/articles/powergrid_international/print/volume-18/issue-2/features/underground-vs-overhead-power-line-installation-cost-comparison-.html). These will be in the sky on the sides of the roads, meaning 3,014 km will be needed, for a total cost of $730,394,676 for a set of lines. This will end up being tripled, due to communication lines being placed as well, and worker pay. This gives a new cost of around $2.2 billion USD. Estimated time is 2 years for this.

The grand total for the first stage comes out to be $3.5 billion USD. China sees this as an investment for a to be world power ally. Total time will come out to be 4 years total..
